features: Carriers and airstrips launch their aircraft together, and those jets and Apaches reload and return home on their own.
Map decorations now appear from coarse art first and upgrade to full detail in place.
Shipyards now build wholly in water beside any coast, and enemy commanders establish naval production too.
Selected aircraft now reveal green controls for choosing a specific compatible landing position.
Destroyers automatically defend against aircraft with heavy rockets alongside their main cannon.
Browse the complete release archive from the sidebar with an index, categories, and deep links.
Hold on a unit for contextual commands, including Follow, and release to choose.
improvements: Prepared the sprite streaming pipeline for bounded diagnostics and safe progressive detail work.
Custom sprite sheets can now be prepared in bounded background workers without blocking gameplay.
Bound streamed sprite memory across loading, replacement, eviction, and teardown.
Keep terrain-page refinement bounded to the pages that use each sprite sheet.
Prepared decoration layouts now keep seeded placement stable across sprite detail tiers.
Map decorations now wait for idle main-thread capacity during scrolling and can fade in after the camera settles.
Deferred sprite loading now follows camera demand and keeps offline derivative downloads bounded.
In-game update alerts now list their new features, improvements and bugfixes.
Prepared map sprite tiers now provide deterministic coarse-to-final artwork without runtime sheet processing.
Stuck units step aside after 10 seconds without progress, and a crowd of your own stuck units can be selected from a notification.
Visible map decorations now use spare main-thread capacity and stay stable while the camera scrolls.
Build placement shows green inside base range, orange outside it, and red on blocked tiles.
Prepared terrain sheets now load demand-driven alpha-ready pages and refresh dependent map pages safely.
Prepared map art can publish a fast coarse representation and converge to stable full detail without stale loads replacing current sprites.
Bound background sprite preparation around visible camera demand and foreground frame headroom.
Sprite memory is tracked in one shared budget, offline play keeps only the needed map sprite tiers, and idle frames no longer re-request sprite demand.
Sprite preparation now safely retries failed work and bounds shared atlas, tier, and explosion resource lifetimes.
Sprite streaming now keeps versioned art consistent while bounding background network and offline work.
Vehicles roll out of a shaded Vehicle Factory doorway.
Game updates download while you play and preserve the paused battlefield while restoring your battle.
Mobile portrait notifications now appear at the top below the device safe area.
Seamless updates are now optional and off by default, with a small top download progress bar.
Muddy ponds on soil maps now appear sparingly through the lake decoration budget.
Pull requests targeting dev now receive a Netlify Deploy Preview for review before merging.
Sharper recovery tank and Apache map art on retina displays, with clearer camouflage and aligned rotor and weapon mounts.
Supply ships service nearby units within a 33% larger radius.
Prepare complete tank rotation sets in a bounded worker job without competing with gameplay on the main thread.
bugfixes: Buildings can no longer be placed on city buildings or stones.
Map decorations and city buildings stay visible after loading a save or changing the selected sprite sheets.
Background music tracks no longer overlap when music changes or finishes loading.
Milestone video narration and embedded audio now respect live changes to the overall game volume.
Build stacks now require Shift-scroll, and cancelled chain building stays off until explicitly enabled again.
Map decorations become visible reliably again after entering the viewport.
Building placement no longer makes decorations across the map disappear and fade back in.
Touch building placement now previews validity under a held finger, places on a valid release, cancels on an invalid release, and starts chain planning only after a deliberate hold-and-drag.
Single-clicking a unit now reliably selects only that unit while genuine double-clicks select matching visible units.
Vehicles now drive through the factory doorway cleanly and accept orders while emerging.
Clicking an aircraft on a carrier, airstrip, or helipad selects the aircraft.
Helicopters now touch down and park on free airstrip positions instead of hovering above them.
Dev deploys build again after soil lake tags by refreshing the prepared map sprite catalog.
Experimental seamless updates preserve staged files and saved-game recovery through restart failures.
Recover cached terrain after canvas context loss and protect visible terrain during fast scrolling.
Ground and sea units avoid movable occupants when given a new move or attack order, then ignore movable occupancy during automatic path updates.
Naval clicks match ship images, and supply ships serve recipients with the correct cursor.
